newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat called mixed amid exports, farm sales.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat called mixed amid exports, farm sales.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were expected to open mixed, with some calling the market steady to one cent higher on USDA's weekly export sales report, traders said.
USDA Thursday said U.S. net export sales of wheat during the week ended July 24 totalled 964,300 tonnes, above expectations for 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes.
But there were many calls for a lower open on signs of farmer selling during recent rallies.
"We were expecting a big export number and I think we'll be lower because there's a lot of farm movement left to come," a trader said.
